text:
The sea rocks its thousands of waves,

divine.

Hearing the loving seas,

I rock my child.

The wandering wind in the night

rocks the wheat.

Hearing the loving winds,

I rock my child.

God the Father rocks his thousands of worlds

without a sound.

Feeling his hand in the darkness,

I rock my child.

translation.title: Rocking
translation.editorial_note: Reuses a reviewed translation of the identical source body.
